editorial:
Ever wonder what happens to actors when the fame fades and the money runs out? You get to see exactly that with three desperate guys who are totally over the hill. They are tired of being forgotten and are willing to do almost anything to get back in the spotlight. When a crazy plan comes along that promises them a big payday and a shot at stardom, they jump in headfirst. The whole vibe is a wild mix of a heist movie and a comedy, making you root for these losers even when they are doing things that are completely wrong. It is a fun ride that pokes fun at the glitz and glamour of Tinseltown.

The acting is the best part because the chemistry between the three leads feels real and funny. You will love the twists that keep you guessing, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like stories about underdogs getting into trouble, you will really enjoy this.
endingExplained: In the end, the guys realize the dangerous plot was a setup to use them as fall guys. They have to use their acting skills one last time to trick the real villains and escape with the money. After a chaotic showdown, they actually manage to pull it off. They don't become world-famous superstars, but they get the financial freedom they wanted and find a way to survive in Hollywood on their own terms.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and stories about unlikely heroes.
